description: Use for recent news headlines and links on a topic (last 1-7 days). Headlines only — use read_page for full article text. $0.004 per call via x402 on GET /news?q=. No free daily check. hours is the lookback window (1-168, default 72); limit caps how many headlines are returned (1-25, default 10). An empty or unmatched query is not charged. Invalid or failed calls are not charged. With no payment, the tool returns error=payment_required and the x402 Payment Required challenge for the HTTP route; pay that USDC amount, then retry the URL.
name: news_search

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: Recent News Search
